epic.title: Migration from React to Angular using AI (internship)

fields.currentSituation: The frontend is implemented in React and the migration work needs a reviewable hierarchy and evidence-driven delivery flow.
fields.desiredOutcome: Migrate bounded frontend features to Angular with reusable AI-assisted analysis, implementation and verification evidence.
fields.whyMatters: The internship must prove a safe migration approach while keeping stakeholders informed about scope, progress and risk.
successCriteria: Each Feature and User Story has a clear bounded outcome.
Progress is derived from completed stakeholder-visible Tasks.
Verified migration evidence supports the decision for each next slice.
fields.richReleaseNotes: Epic hierarchy and first bounded migration workflow prepared.

epic.structureComment:
EPIC - Migrate frontend from React to Angular
|
+-- Feature - Map Making
    |
    +-- User Story - Detail drawer
    +-- User Story - Right side drawer / toolbox
    +-- User Story - Line drawing
    +-- User Story - Add objects
    +-- User Story - Lidar image overlay

fields.currentSituation: The map-making experience is implemented in React and direct drawlib integrations.
fields.desiredOutcome: Migrate bounded map-making slices to Angular while preserving observable behavior.
fields.whyMatters: A bounded migration reduces integration risk and produces reusable migration evidence.
successCriteria: The approved Detail Drawer slice preserves its agreed scenarios.
React retains application and canvas ownership during the POC.
fields.richReleaseNotes: Baseline prepared for the first bounded Angular migration slice.

fields.userValue: As a map editor, I want to edit a selected line in an Angular drawer so that the map updates without losing existing behavior.
fields.currentBehavior: React owns the drawer and updates the selected drawlib line.
fields.desiredBehavior: Angular owns only the drawer and communicates through typed inputs, commands and events.
acceptanceCriteria: The drawer shows the selected line identifier, length and angle.
Valid edits update the SVG and preserve undo and redo.
Invalid edits show the agreed visible validation outcome.
Closing and reopening does not retain stale state or duplicate listeners.
attentionPoints: Validate one representative scenario in the required host environment.
Do not expand ownership to routing, Auth0, Maui or the canvas container.
fields.attachmentInformation: Attach the approved baseline report and Flow Contract references; do not attach source copies.
fields.richReleaseNotes: Behavior baseline and acceptance criteria prepared; implementation has not started.

tasks.title: Establish Detail Drawer behavior baseline
tasks.description: Document current behavior, acceptance scenarios, evidence gaps, scope and approval requirements.
doneWhen: The baseline report and draft Flow Contract validate.
Acceptance scenarios and open decisions are visible.
evidence: Validated baseline report and draft Flow Contract.

tasks.title: Implement the bounded Angular Detail Drawer
tasks.description: Add missing React characterization evidence and implement the approved Angular slice with scoped checkpoints.
doneWhen: The Angular slice and matching tests pass.
Every product checkpoint is allowlisted and verified.
blockers: Flow Contract and Angular conventions require approval.

tasks.title: Verify the Detail Drawer migration
tasks.description: Independently verify all contract scenarios and the required host scenario before proposing Done.
doneWhen: The verified branch push outcome is recorded.
blockers: A host validation owner and environment must be assigned.

completedSincePreviousUpdate: Prepared and validated the Detail Drawer behavior baseline and draft Flow Contract.
next: Review the open product and Angular decisions before implementation approval.
blockers: Invalid-input behavior, Angular conventions and host validation ownership are not approved.
standup.summary: Detail Drawer is at 20%: the baseline is complete. Next is contract approval; implementation is blocked by the open product, Angular and host decisions.

manualApplication.summary: Copy the proposed Epic, Feature, User Story, Tasks and standup update into TopDesk and confirm what was applied.

evidence: Canonical selected-line Detail Drawer POC boundary.
